name.zh: SRA 高速下载（自动单双端）

description.en: Downloads full-quality SRA objects from the official NCBI AWS public bucket with resumable ranges, automatically detects SINGLE or PAIRED layout per accession, and creates verified FASTQ files with fasterq-dump and pigz. The bundled offline runtime builds locally on first use without a public container registry.
description.zh: 从 NCBI 官方 AWS 公共桶分片高速下载完整质量 SRA，逐个 accession 自动识别单端或双端，再用 fasterq-dump 与 pigz 生成并校验 FASTQ。插件自带离线运行环境，首次运行本地构建镜像，不依赖公共镜像站。
